name: Egg Hunt
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hey, adventurer. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
narrative.objectives: Bring 12 Silithid Eggs and the Digging Claw to Korran at the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You please me, adventurer. The eggs and the tool. Well done.

And for your reward...
narrative.requestItemsText: Be careful with the eggs you find, adventurer. If they break, they be no good to me.
